SwiftMath 1.7.3 (MIT)
https://github.com/mgriebling/SwiftMath
Revision: fa8244ed032f4a1ade4cb0571bf87d2f1a9fd2d7

Sources and mathFonts.bundle are included for reproducible offline builds.
Local changes: remove the upstream test target (tests are not vendored); route
font resource lookup through MathResources so signed macOS apps load fonts from
Contents/Resources/SwiftMath_SwiftMath.bundle, with the SwiftPM bundle as fallback.
Upstream source license is in LICENSE; font licenses remain in mathFonts.bundle.
